finding.expected: Preserve exact two-pass MOA contract. Any unresolved first-pass BLOCKER/UNKNOWN must prohibit a final CANDIDATE and speculative draft/handoff. If reconciliation is permissible, require explicit bounded, evidence-grounded disposition linked to the precise first-pass blocker and its affected source/causal basis; never infer resolution merely because later checks say CLEAR. Add focused regression: first-pass UNKNOWN/BLOCKER with otherwise valid sources and all-clear second-pass must fail closed or yield NO_DECISION until lawfully reconciled, retaining frontier, source, historical and profile compatibility.
finding.issue: A CONSTRUCT first-pass check may declare BLOCKER with UNKNOWN causal/authority judgment, yet construct_moa can retain a draft and validate_moa derives the final outcome solely from second-pass challenges. A second pass with all CLEAR and unchanged final draft can therefore yield CANDIDATE without explicitly resolving the first-pass blocker. No targeted negative regression covers this first-pass-to-final closure gap.
